done.description: true when the site renders without errors and matches the design image as closely as you can make it

fidelity.description: 5 = mistaken for the design image at a glance, 4 = same layout/palette/type/frame with small detail differences, 3 = same design with missing or misplaced elements, 2 = palette only, 1 = unrelated

remaining_differences.description: concrete visible differences you could not close, each naming the region and what differs

what.description: region and what differs, e.g. 'toolbar: design image has 9 distinct icons, render uses 5 generic squares'

cause.description: site = fixable by editing the site files; kit = needs a kit/task change (KIT_REQUESTS.md); seed = seeded content; font = exact typeface only

deviations.description: intentional departures the env contract forced (e.g. seeded content instead of the depicted names)
